name: ggml-speech
description: Speech-stack ggml flavour (tetherto/qvac-ext-ggml@speech). This pin teaches the Vulkan backend to CPY from the k-quants to F32 (PR #47): pipeline_cpy_quant_f32 covered only the legacy quants (Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0, IQ4_NL), so ggml_cast(<k-quant> -> F32) had no pipeline to bind and hit the GGML_ABORT at the end of ggml_vk_get_cpy_pipeline -- 'Missing CPY op for types: q4_K f32'. Every Vulkan audiogen runner aborted on it, because the ACE-Step FSQ detokenizer casts a Q4_K special-tokens tensor to F32 in-graph and there is no CPU fallback to absorb it (supports_op correctly returns false, but the stage computes with a direct single-backend call). Carries the prior pin's GGML_PREC_F32 work on Vulkan and Metal (PR #46) and the Vulkan ACE-Step Oobleck VAE custom ops (PR #45). CPU output is unchanged.

metal-fuse-mv-bias.description: Compile in the Q-variant mul_mv + ADD(bias) [+ ADD(residual)] fusion in ggml-metal. Off by default: empirically produces zero tokens on parakeet's EOU q8_0 joint network. Opt in only after Metal A/B-validating your model against the fused path.
